name: agrsearth-plugin-template
description: 航遥业务中台插件开发模板仓（同步源：平台仓 extensions/_template/）：@agrsearth/* 本地 workspace 共享包 + tool/system 双轨最小骨架 + L1-L10 分层开发指南

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agrsearth/vite-config && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run build -w @agrsearth/vite-config && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.docs:html: mkdir -p docs/html && for f in docs/L*.md; do python3 tools/md-to-html.py "$f" "docs/html/$(basename "$f" .md).html"; done
